Application Data.NAME: Green Leaf Coffee House
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Leaf Coffee House is a cozy establishment dedicated to serving high-quality coffee and a variety of specialty teas in a warm, inviting atmosphere. Our operations include brewing fresh coffee daily, preparing tea selections, and offering light pastries and snacks. We prioritize customer experience, maintaining a seating capacity of 50 patrons within a well-maintained space of 2,000 square feet. We do not serve alcohol or have live entertainment, ensuring a peaceful environment for our guests. Open year-round, we emphasize strong fire safety protocols and maintain comprehensive internal controls to mitigate risks associated with cash handling and inventory management.
